in_sanskrit.name: तन्मोय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tan- (tan-) means that which is woven or extended, and Moy (moy) means mind or intelligence. Thus, Tanmoy means the one who has a vast, extensive mind or intelligence.

in_hindi.name: तन्मोय
in_hindi.meaning: तन्- (tan-) + मोय (moy) = तन्-मोय = सोचा, औद्यंक़ (socha, audyamkha) = thought, intelligence
in_hindi.long_meaning: Tan- (tan-) in Hindi can be translated to 'that which is woven or extended', and Moy (moy) means mind or intelligence. Thus, Tanmoy means the one who has a vast, extensive mind or intelligence, or the one who thinks deeply or is intelligent.

in_tamil.name: தன்மோய்
in_tamil.meaning: தன் (tan) + மோய் (moy) = தன்-மோய் = மனம் (manam) = mind, intelligence
in_tamil.long_meaning: Tan- (tan) in Tamil can be translated to 'self' or 'own', and Moy (moy) means mind or intelligence. Thus, Tanmoy means the one who has his own mind or intelligence, or the one who thinks for himself.

in_telugu.name: తన్మోయ
in_telugu.meaning: తన్ (tan) + మోయ (moy) = తన్-మోయ = మీద (mida) = mind, intelligence
in_telugu.long_meaning: Tan- (tan) in Telugu can be translated to 'self' or 'own', and Moy (moy) means mind or intelligence. Thus, Tanmoy means the one who has his own mind or intelligence, or the one who thinks for himself.

in_marathi.name: Tanmoy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tanmoy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tanmoy is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'tanu' meaning body and 'maya' meaning illusion. The name Tanmoy signifies a person who is intelligent and wise, one who can distinguish between reality and illusion.
